title: Opening Project and Capital Schedule — Workplace Cafe Management Program
content:
Workplace Cafe Management Program — Opening Project and Capital Schedule

Every service model of the Workplace Cafe Management Program carries its own capital and opening cost schedule, fixing the one-off opening project fee, the calendar days of opening lead time required before service may commence, the refundable equipment deposit held for the term, the annual smallwares replacement allowance included, and the opening food and beverage inventory invested at commencement.

| Service model | Opening project fee (USD) | Opening lead time (calendar days) | Refundable equipment deposit (USD) | Annual smallwares allowance (USD) | Opening inventory investment (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Grab & Go Cafe Service | 2400.00 USD | 21 calendar days | 3500.00 USD | 600.00 USD | 1200.00 USD |
| Limited Service Cafe | 6800.00 USD | 35 calendar days | 9200.00 USD | 1900.00 USD | 3400.00 USD |
| Full Service Cafe | 18500.00 USD | 60 calendar days | 26500.00 USD | 5400.00 USD | 9800.00 USD |
| Culinary Center Cafe | 42000.00 USD | 90 calendar days | 68000.00 USD | 12800.00 USD | 19500.00 USD |
| Executive Dining Service | 31500.00 USD | 75 calendar days | 44500.00 USD | 9600.00 USD | 14200.00 USD |
| Campus Dining Commons Service | 96000.00 USD | 120 calendar days | 155000.00 USD | 24500.00 USD | 38500.00 USD |

The opening project fee and the opening lead time both rise with service model tier, though the Executive Dining Service model carries a longer opening lead time and a smaller opening project fee than the Culinary Center Cafe model, reflecting the different capital shape of a smaller, richer-spec site set against a larger-volume site. The refundable equipment deposit exceeds the opening project fee at every service model.

Consider a hypothetical client mobilising a site under the Culinary Center Cafe model. The opening project fee printed against that model is 42000.00 USD, the opening lead time required before service may commence is 90 calendar days, the refundable equipment deposit held for the term is 68000.00 USD, the annual smallwares replacement allowance included is 12800.00 USD, and the opening food and beverage inventory invested at commencement is 19500.00 USD.
